environment.description: Deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind an Application Load Balancer with no additional request filtering. The container runs as uid 1000 with standard Linux capabilities. The ALB forwards all POST requests matching /api/* to the target group. No additional middleware or security agents are installed. The subprocess runs under the same user context with default seccomp profile (docker default). The /opt/reporting/templates/ directory contains legitimate .sh scripts owned by root but world-readable and executable.

config.capabilities: default Docker capabilities (CAP_CHOWN, CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE, CAP_FOWNER, CAP_SETGID, CAP_SETUID, etc.)
config.alb_rules: forward all /api/* to target group, no WAF attached
